# Aouda

> Aouda is a columnar database engine for .NET with a TypeScript client SDK (`@aouda/client`).
> Dual deployment: embedded (in-process, no server needed) or server (standalone HTTP server).
> Schema-on-write by default. Zero index management. Local server via `aouda start`.
> Two-layer auth model: server auth (who can connect) + application auth (your app's end users).

## Quick orientation

- Install CLI: `dotnet tool install -g Aouda.Cli`
- Start server: `aouda start` (code default port `5000`; install scripts use `5433` — override with `--port` and `--data-dir`)
- Install .NET client: `dotnet add package Aouda.Client`
- Install TypeScript client: `npm install @aouda/client`
- Docker: `docker run -p 5000:5000 -v aouda-data:/data aouda/server`

- [Testing](https://aoudadb.github.io/getting-started/testing/): In-process integration tests with Aouda.Testing package
- [Backup and Restore](https://aoudadb.github.io/getting-started/backup/): Incremental backups, PITR, S3-compatible storage

- [Auth and Authorization Overview](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/): Two independent auth systems — server auth vs application auth
- [Auth Architecture](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/architecture/): Deployment models A-D, ADRA modes, PLS/RLS
- [Setup and Flows](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/setup/): Signup, signin, token lifecycle, practical setup sequences
- [Client Integration](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/client-integration/): .NET and TypeScript integration patterns
- [Data Authorization](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/authorization/): ADRA modes — jwt-claim, auth-db-pls, auth-db-rls
- [Use Cases](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/use-cases/): Common implementation patterns, password reset, MFA
- [Email, SMS & Notifications](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/notifications/): SendGrid, GatewayAPI, OTP delivery configuration
- [Auth Reference](https://aoudadb.github.io/auth/reference/): API endpoints, error codes, local developer setup

## Core Guides

- [How to build apps effortlessly with Aouda](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/build-apps/): **Start here for any application.** The canonical build path — the tiers you do not build, 10-minute app, twelve-step sequence, capability map, alternatives per constraint, agent rules and error contract
- [Adopting Aouda in an existing app](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/adoption/): Target architecture, which hops to delete, SDK coverage gaps, migration order
- [Named queries and mutations](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/named-queries/): Name identity, optional Args/Row types, subscribe-by-name
- [Freshness and replica consistency](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/freshness/): Consistency token (`AtLeast`), named-query alias `freshness`, `GET …/token`, caveats (scale-out store, clock skew, `MaxLagSeconds`, `w:1` failover). Wire: [HTTP API — Consistency tokens](https://aoudadb.github.io/reference/http-api/#consistency-tokens-and-freshness)
- [What a browser-tier read cannot do](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/browser-tier-read-limits/): Operators, data-plane allowlist, partition-filter rule, conflation caveat
- [Direct client access](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/direct-client-access/): Admin vs data-plane listeners, `mk_pub_*`, quotas, thin edge. PKCE is not shipped.
- [Division of responsibility](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/division-of-responsibility/): What belongs in Aouda vs a service; decision test; latency caveat
- [Insert-time transforms](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/insert-transforms/): derived columns, checks, route/tee, bulk-load intent, unique/references
- [Access-surface diff](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/access-surface/): `aouda schema diff --access` CI gate on widening
- [Query Execution](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/query/): Runtime model, predicates, joins, aggregations, pagination
- [Schema Lifecycle](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/schema/): Schema-on-write, explicit schema, evolution, inference modes
- [Schema Management](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/schema-management/): Declarative schema, aouda.schema.json, diff and apply
- [Schema CI/CD](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/schema-cicd/): Schema lifecycle in CI/CD pipelines
- [Hot/Cold Storage](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/hot-cold/): Memory control, temperature policies, hot retention
- [Write Path Durability](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/write-durability/): WAL model, write concern, crash recovery
- [Real-time Streaming](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/real-time/): WebSocket streaming, availability status, usage playbooks
- [Backup and Restore](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/backup/): Incremental manifests, PITR, retention, REST APIs
- [Replication and Clustering](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/replication/): Cluster lifecycle, witness role, node management
- [Partitioning and Multi-tenancy](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/partitioning/): Partition keys, tenant isolation
- [Time-series and Clustering](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/time-series/): Cluster declaration, partition functions, delta handling
- [Materialized Queries](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/materialized/): Materialized query definitions, refresh, Studio browser
- [Market Data and Stock Quotes](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/market-data/): **P40 browser-tier worked example.** Watchlist subscribe, `latestPerKey` last-price, candle chart via `outputName`, paged screener with `whenParamPresent`, top-gainers with computed MQ + `orderByChoices`. Conformance fixture: `examples/p40-browser-tier/`
- [Storage and Persistence](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/storage/): Columnar storage model, segment lifecycle, WAL
- [Cloud and Hub](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/cloud-hub/): Hub backend, cloud control plane, Kubernetes operator
- [Studio](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/studio/): Web management console — data explorer, cluster ops, backup UI
- [Testing and DX](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/testing-dx/): Aouda.Testing package, xUnit/NUnit/MSTest fixtures
- [Bulk Load](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/bulk-load/)
- [Graph and Vector](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/graph-vector/)
- [Primary Key Indexing and Memory](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/pk-indexing/)
- [Server and Multi-Database](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/server-multi-database/)
- [Server configuration](https://aoudadb.github.io/guides/server-configuration/): Precedence (Setup, env, CLI, appsettings), restart behavior, data-dir persistence

- [AI Agent Usage](https://aoudadb.github.io/ai/): AI-native bootstrap, two-layer auth for generated apps, ADRA modes, error contracts

- [Local CLI testing (agents)](https://aoudadb.github.io/ai/local-cli-testing/): Throwaway `aouda start` recipe — unused ports, temp data-dir, pin CLI; traps (`start -h` boots :5000, data-plane name execute not `/query`, CorsOrigins is one string, schema/where/offset/keys)

## Reference

- [HTTP API Reference](https://aoudadb.github.io/reference/http-api/): Wire protocol, REST + WebSocket. v2.5: named-query name identity. P37: named-query execute/batch, named mutations, `mk_pub_*` / listeners, `snapshot_complete`, `gap`, `re_auth`, `values_skipped`
- [Timestamp Type](https://aoudadb.github.io/reference/timestamp/): Timestamp semantics, storage, query behavior
